name: Karthikeyan Selvam
headline: AI & Automation Practice Leader · 19+ years in enterprise IT
summary: AI and automation practice leader with 19+ years in enterprise IT, 11+ at Atos, a global systems integrator. Supplies the AI business case in enterprise proposals and bids, turns agentic use-case analysis into pilot plans and roadmaps, and leads an engineering team building governed AI agents, while staying hands-on as a builder. Led Atos's pre-launch evaluation of Microsoft Copilot for Entra (83 bugs logged, 19 resolved before general availability) and has delivered programs up to $20M.

scope.items: Lead an engineering team of application developers, software engineers, cloud and design talent building governed AI agents; earlier led cross-functional onshore/offshore teams of automation consultants, business analysts and developers.
Programs from $200K to $20M: plans, budgets, vendors and stakeholder communications owned end to end.

Microsoft (Copilot for Entra) · a major energy utility (AIOps, backup) · a large US healthcare provider (Windows 11) · enterprise clients in financial services, insurance and life sciences (proposals, bids, architecture reviews) · Atos internal functions.

skills.items: AI strategy and roadmaps · AI transformation · AI practice leadership · AI pre-sales, proposals and business cases · agentic use-case analysis · AI governance and responsible AI · Copilot enablement, change management and adoption · people, stakeholder and vendor management

Generative AI and agentic AI · Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Gemini) · Azure AI Foundry · AWS Bedrock AgentCore · Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio · Claude · multi-agent systems · LLM evaluation · Python · LangGraph · Model Context Protocol (MCP)

Program management · Agile, Scrum, PRINCE2 · Lean and Six Sigma methods · go-to-market and offering packaging · AI product management · RPA (UiPath, Power Automate) · ServiceNow · AIOps (Nexthink) · Power BI

experience.title: Business Manager — AI & Automation Practice
experience.org: Atos, North America — Cloud & Modern Infrastructure
bullets: Lead the AI and automation practice across North America: set priorities, delivery plans and the governed build framework (patterns, standards, skills) the engineering team works to; own budget, resourcing and performance management, with monthly 1:1s and objectives coaching.

Supply the AI side of large deals across multiple proposals and bids: AI business cases with savings and costed investment options, executive proposals for governed agentic pilots, statement-of-work reviews, architecture in solution and client security reviews, and a co-designed agentic architecture on AWS Bedrock AgentCore.

Run agentic use-case analysis with customers and internal teams (consolidated 150+ AI use-case submissions into 20 agent families), separating good agent candidates from simple workflows, then shape the pilot plan, platform recommendation and roadmap.

Proposed role-based AI bootcamps and a learn-build-deploy-scale capability model to leadership; authored a 12-week Copilot Enablement Playbook (build, action, sustain) built on peer champions, leaders modeling usage and measured adoption.

Still hands-on: built a multi-agent AI platform on Google Cloud and governed agents (read-only, human-approved or limited to explicit low-risk rules), with role-based access, audit logs, automated migration off retired models and cost controls.

experience.title: Digital Workplace Consultant — Windows 11 Migration
experience.org: Atos — client: a large US healthcare provider
bullets: Ran delivery of a 12,000-device Windows 11 migration ahead of Windows 10 end of support, using AI-assisted analytics for hardware compatibility and application readiness.

Designed rollout approaches with senior leadership (refresh, White Glove provisioning, LTSC fallback); ran daily leadership calls and weekly executive summaries, and owned baseline-reset and burn-down reporting.

experience.title: Technical Service Delivery Manager & Solution Architect — Microsoft Copilot for Entra
experience.org: Atos — client: Microsoft (Entra skills in Microsoft Security Copilot)
bullets: Led the Atos evaluation team grading Copilot for Entra prompts and responses; authored the delivery plan and rubric (language accuracy, technical correctness, user satisfaction) and ran calibration and grading.

The team logged 83 bugs with Microsoft Engineering, 19 resolved (6 critical) before general availability, and helped lift response satisfaction from about 42% to 57%; packaged the work into a reusable Copilot quality-analysis offering.

bullets: Owned the roadmap for a proactive digital-experience capability with Nexthink and ServiceNow AIOps across a 40,000-device estate, building on an AIOps proof of concept delivered on time and on budget (customer: "lead from the front brilliantly").
Delivered a Quest enterprise backup and recovery program: plans, budgets, vendor management, restoration drills and failover validation.
